<div class="card-body">
'''Tatooine''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">タトゥイーンを占領している場合、ここにいる自分の宇宙船1隻につき、タトゥイーンの位置カード上での戦闘時で、合計戦力に＋1。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-127o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">タトゥイーンを占領している場合、ここにいる自分の宇宙船１隻につき、タトゥイーンの位置カード上での戦闘時で、合計戦力に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja"></span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tatooine.

'''Card text:''' If you control Tatooine, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.

'''Lore:'''

'''Dark Side card text:''' If you occupy Tatooine, total power in battles at Tatooine sites is +1 for each of your starships here.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine (Light) (Premiere)|Tatooine]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100.
